categories.main_business_segments: AIDA ENGINEERING, LTD. operates primarily in the manufacturing and sale of metal forming machinery, with a focus on press machines. The company also provides automation equipment for press processing, industrial robots, dies, and related services. Its business is structured regionally into five segments: Japan, China, Asia, Americas, and Europe, each responsible for manufacturing, sales, and service activities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include the development and manufacturing of high-speed and precision press machines, servo press systems with proprietary servo motors, and automation/FA equipment. It emphasizes advanced control systems, DX/AI integration for predictive maintenance and process optimization, and energy-efficient forming technologies. Proprietary developments such as the BEX series for metal separator forming and wide-area high-speed presses for EV motor cores are notable.
categories.primary_customers_markets: AIDA's main customers are automotive industry suppliers, accounting for over three-quarters of its sales, as well as manufacturers in the electrical and electronics sectors. The company serves global automotive OEMs and parts suppliers, with growing focus on EV-related components, alternative energy, and industrial automation markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: AIDA operates globally with production, sales, and service bases in Japan, China, Southeast Asia (notably Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, India, Vietnam, and the Philippines), the Americas (primarily the US, Canada, Mexico, Brazil), and Europe (Italy, Germany, Morocco). Its sales are well-diversified internationally, with significant revenue from Japan, the US, China, and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: AIDA is positioned as an equipment manufacturer (midstream), supplying capital machinery and automation systems to downstream manufacturers, primarily automotive and industrial parts producers. It does not produce raw materials but provides essential production equipment and after-sales services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include shifting the business portfolio toward growth areas such as EV and environmental products, expanding automation/FA and service businesses, and enhancing product differentiation through advanced technology. R&D focuses on solutions for EVs (motor cores, battery cases), alternative energy (hydrogen fuel cell components), DX/AI-driven production systems, and energy-saving forming technologies. The company is also investing in global production optimization and local supply capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: AIDA generates revenue primarily through the sale of press machines, automation equipment, and related systems, as well as after-sales services, modernization, and parts sales. For some digital solutions (e.g., Ai CARE analytics), it is expanding into subscription-based models. Long-term contracts and project-based sales are common for large equipment.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: AIDA is a global leader in press machinery, competing with other major press and forming equipment manufacturers such as Amada, Komatsu, Schuler, and JIER. The company is recognized for its technological innovation, especially in servo presses and high-speed precision forming, and maintains a strong position in the automotive sector, particularly for EV-related applications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, AIDA reported consolidated sales of 76.0 billion yen, operating profit of 5.5 billion yen, and net profit attributable to parent company shareholders of 5.1 billion yen. The company has shown steady revenue growth (4.5% YoY), significant profit improvement (operating profit up 53%), and maintains a strong balance sheet with a high equity ratio (68%). Its mid-term plan targets 78 billion yen in sales and 5.8 billion yen in operating profit for FY2025.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: AIDA emphasizes its ability to deliver innovative, high-performance press systems tailored to next-generation automotive and energy needs, including EV and hydrogen-related solutions. Its differentiation lies in proprietary servo technology, integrated automation, advanced DX/AI features, and global support capabilities. The company positions itself as a comprehensive forming system builder, offering not just machines but complete, efficient, and sustainable production solutions.
